tripleseat_booking_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a booking is changed, such as its status or dates, with what it says now.

parameters.description: Only bookings at this location. Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

tripleseat_event_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an event is changed (its status, date, guest count or any other detail), with what it says now.

parameters.description: Only events at this location. Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

tripleseat_new_account_trigger.description: Runs when an account (a company, organisation or family) is added in Tripleseat.

tripleseat_new_booking_trigger.description: Runs when a booking is added in Tripleseat.

parameters.description: Only bookings at this location. Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

tripleseat_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact (a person) is added in Tripleseat.

tripleseat_new_event_trigger.description: Runs when an event is added in Tripleseat, at every location or the one you choose.

parameters.description: Only events at this location. Leave blank for every location.
parameters.name: location

tripleseat_new_lead_trigger.description: Runs when a lead (an event enquiry) comes in, from your lead form, email or someone on your team. Leads already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.
